scope: Optional native-preflight/native-evidence manual modes in the existing production-verification workflow; same five jobs and unchanged full/default/push/PR qualification scope.
Focused orchestrator source/control/producer/artifact binding, native serial scheduling, failure preservation, cancellation forwarding and owned outer cleanup.
Release workflow contract predicates, Linux-executable mocked control tests, and focused-mode operator documentation.
Toolchain-profile/archived-runner portability and copy-only single-tap fixture are independently owned/reviewed by other agents, not newly approved by this report.

findings.finding: Initial native result handling parsed a receipt before preserving raw failed or malformed evidence.
findings.correction: run_native finally invokes bounded raw preservation before parsing. Incomplete preservation stays unsafe, prevents B and prevents canonical evidence deletion. Missing/malformed/symlink partial evidence regressions are present.

findings.finding: Pathname-only file checks could miss a replacement at open or final mode/owner/link drift.
findings.correction: O_NOFOLLOW and the same dev/inode/size/mtime/mode/uid/nlink identity at pre-open, opened fd, post-read fd and final path. Regressions swap opened descriptor, refuse symlink, and mutate post-fd hardlink/mode while bytes/inode remain stable.

findings.finding: Outer cleanup could retain a PASS status if staging rmtree failed after qualification.
findings.correction: Exception handler explicitly resets FAIL and retains an error; regression covers postqualification deletion failure. Other tests cover successful upload, failed/missing upload, unsafe native cleanup, hash/inode/symlink drift and unrelated sentinel preservation.

findings.finding: Cleanup predicate needed actual worker/holder/source/control/stop reconciliation without treating xcodebuild -version as a build attempt.
findings.correction: Requires safe canonical source/control equality, worker/holder/secondary-error/finalization/device fields. Actual test/build attempts require both distinct zero-exit immediate/final Gradle stops and unchanged copy sources; read-only prebuild observation does not invent Gradle attempts. Raw historical A16/B15 failure receipt schemas reopened.

findings.finding: Signal handler installation after Popen had a launch/assignment cancellation window.
findings.correction: Install handlers before spawn, retain pending signal until exact child assignment, forward SIGTERM and wait for bounded native finalizer without direct kill; restore prior handlers. Deterministic mocked signal-during-Popen test, timeout/grace and unfinished-finalizer tests are present.

findings.finding: Evidence traversal/error handling needed bounded failure handling, including os.walk default silent scandir omissions.
findings.correction: Directory/file/byte/error ceilings are enforced. Both walks use explicit raising onerror; preservation catches traversal error once and stays INCOMPLETE while retaining already copied receipt/log bytes. Mocked directory-read failure regression cannot pass through silent omission.

findings.finding: Consumer evidence originally needed retained checked producer API facts, not only requested IDs/digests.
findings.correction: Allowlisted run/workflow/repository/artifact observations are retained and can be fed back through producer validation offline. No API/signed URL, actor or token is retained. Roundtrip and authorization-nonforwarding regressions are present.

source_conclusions: Full/default/push/PR keep the existing five-job qualification; only explicit native scopes skip other jobs and full Apple steps. Unknown dispatch scope fails before focused execution. Full finalizers retain exact always() plus full-scope predicate. Immutable Action pins and disabled Store workflows remain untouched.

Preflight invokes the official source binder and both control-manifest commands only, producing exactly four artifact files. Requires exact continuation repository/branch/workflow, GITHUB_SHA/GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA/frozen SHA, clean checkout and full history. Qualified Xcode26.3/build17C529, SDK/runtime26.2 and arm64 observations are strict, with no fallback.

Native execution requires separately reviewed preflight producer run/attempt/artifact ID/digest and both control hashes at the same frozen source. Download checks successful producer source/workflow/repository ownership, exact bounded ZIP contents and current binding/control/toolchain bytes before any build.

Authenticated API requests are fixed read-only same-repository Actions endpoints with redirect disabled. Separate signed Azure blob request receives no Authorization header. Archive bytes are read bounded and never extractall-executed.

Canonical A17 composed L08 and B18 normal Debug execute serially with explicit adhoc signing/qualified profile, B explicitly uses libproc. A strict/partial failure remains NOT_READY/nonzero; B proceeds only after actual safe cleanup/source/control observations, not merely harness status.

Canonical runners remain the only build/simulator/copy/worker owners and retain immediate/final isolated Gradle stops. Outer cleanup verifies uploaded custody, exact file/directory ownership and unchanged manifests, deletes only known task paths, and never removes global caches. Missing dependency-cache directories may only be created and recorded.

No application reducer, protocol4.2, deterministic seed, privacy boundary, strict snapshot/content validation, Doctor behavior, Whodunit Leave Confirmation timing, application identity or Store-operation change occurs in these six files.

historical_receipt_basis.use: Reopened raw receipt to check cleanup schema compatibility only; historical failure is not new runtime evidence.

execution_conditions: Coordinator must execute focused Linux controls for these exact hashes, retain actual counts/failures/skips/source maps, stop Gradle and perform ownership cleanup in the single coordinated lane. Declared methods are not executed tests.
Complete the existing release validator including workflow security, actionlint/ShellCheck and mechanical inventory freshness before dispatch; source review is not those executable results.

Commit reviewed source/control changes, then regenerate/commit mechanical inventory. Create fresh run-specific hosted source/control bindings for that frozen revision; this dirty-worktree source review is not a future control-manifest approval.

Independently inspect actual four-file preflight artifact, API/digest/run identities and qualified toolchain observations before authorizing native execution. Native execution approval remains false here.

Read actual native receipts, xcresult descriptors, Foundation protection rows, libproc target/image/ABI observations and cleanup receipts. A passing control suite or compilation must not be described as application/runtime/protection proof.
